detail: Parcels not sold at the Colorado tax lien sale stay with the county as county-held tax liens, which the treasurer assigns on request; a Treasurer's Deed option is sold at public auction (HB 24-1056). Both are lien / auction instruments - neither is government-held property available to buy - so they belong in Liens & Certificates or Auctions, never in Available.
evidence: web search 2026-10-02: Douglas County Treasurer's Deed Information page; El Paso County 'County Held Tax Liens'; Morgan County 'treasurers deed option auctions'

detail: Wyoming counties sell tax liens, not property; a parcel nobody buys is bid in for the county as a county-held certificate of purchase.
